The focus for this role is to be the trusted advisor for manufacturing, engineering, and procurement teams at the factory. You will be part of a global legal team that supports facilities and special projects throughout the world. jobs.description: What to ExpectThe Tesla EMEA Indirect Procurement team is looking for a highly motivated Supply Chain Manager to support procurement for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment across the broader EMEA region. You will partner closely with Engineering, Facilities, Finance, and operations stakeholders to source and manage complex service, supplies and equipment spend — from engineering consultancies, test and lab services, and specialized technical support through to engineering equipment, tooling, and infrastructure investments. This role requires a hands-on buyer who can drive end-to-end sourcing, negotiate commercial terms, ensure compliant purchase-to-pay execution, and keep critical engineering and capital programs on schedule and on budget.What You’ll Do- Serve as the primary Indirect Procurement partner for Engineering Services, Supplies and Equipment demand across EMEA, translating business requirements into clear scopes of work, sourcing strategies, and executable purchase packages.- Lead end-to-end sourcing for engineering services (e.g., design/engineering support, testing, prototyping services, technical consultancy, and specialized lab/operations support) and engineering supplies (e.g., lab consumables, non-production hardware, development materials) and equipment categories (tooling, fixtures, facility and infrastructure investments).- Own RFx processes (RFI/RFP/RFQ): develop bid packages, run competitive tenders, evaluate commercial and technical proposals, and present award recommendations that balance cost, lead time, quality, risk, and supplier capability.- Dive deep into supplier quotes and statements of work to challenge scope, pricing structures, rates, milestones, and total cost of ownership; international, fast-growing environment where fashion, sustainability, and customer experience come together.If you love helping people, care about sustainability, and enjoy working in a dynamic team—this is the opportunity for you.About the RoleWe are working on behalf of an exciting and fast-growing Social Hospitality platform.As a Customer Experience Specialist, you’ll be the voice of the brand—delivering outstanding service and creating memorable experiences for customers across Europe.How You’ll Make an Impact- Supporting customers across phone, email, chat, and social channels- Delivering personalised interactions through empathy, active listening, and clear communication- Guiding customers to the best solutions, ensuring a seamless experience- Identifying recurring issues and sharing insights to improve processes- Contributing to key KPIs such as customer satisfaction, quality, and productivity- Strengthening customer loyalty through exceptional, human-first serviceWhy This Role Stands Out- Be part of a purpose-driven company- Work in an energetic, international environment- Make a real impact on customer experience and brand perception- Grow professionally in a supportive, fast-paced scale-up cultureWhat We Are Looking For?- Native-level German and a good level of English- Strong communication skills with a natural ability to empathise- A customer-first mindset and solution-oriented approach- Team spirit and enthusiasm for a collaborative environment- Flexibility and comfort in a fast-paced setting- Familiarity with tools such as Google Workspace, MS Office, and CRM systems- A unique personality that adds value to a diverse teamWhat’s in It for You?- Live and work in sunny Valencia, Spain- Breakfast and lunch provided at the office- Spanish health insurance included- Free Spanish language classes- Career development and growth opportunities- Monthly team events, socials, and fitness activities- Full relocation support to help you settle in easilyReady to Apply?If you’re passionate about customer experience and want to build your career abroad—this is your chance to join something meaningful.

We shape trust in the digital age!At G+D, we are creating confidence, with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. To our customers, we have been a reliable partner for more than 170 years. With our offering, we are well positioned to support them on their future journey. Discover our innovative SecurityTech solutions!We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to design, secure, and operate our robust development infrastructure across on‑premise and Azure environments. In this role, you will help drive our evolution towards Platform Engineering by enabling self-service capabilities, automation, and a secure software delivery lifecycle. You will be part of a cross‑site, Kanban‑driven DevSecOps team spanning Germany and India, supporting more than 200 developers while helping to ensure secure and reliable product delivery.Key Responsibilities- Own the development platform: Manage, scale, and evolve our development infrastructure, tools, and platform services across on-premises and cloud environments, with Azure DevOps as the CI/CD backbone- Automate infrastructure delivery: Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using Ansible and Terraform to ensure scalable, repeatable, and reliable platform deployments.- Build secure CI/CD pipelines: Implement and maintain multi-stage pipelines with integrated security controls, quality gates, and automated testing, following DevSecOps best practices.- Establish AI capabilities: Build and evolve platforms, tooling, and processes for agentic AI solutions, AI-enabled engineering, and self-hosted LLM services.- Observability: Establish and evolve monitoring, logging and alerting to ensure operational excellence.- Mentor & collaborate: Work closely with development teams in Germany and India, promote engineering standards, and support continuous improvement initiatives.- Operational excellence: Create documentation, runbooks, and knowledge assets while participating in incident response and critical delivery activities.Required Skills- Bachelor or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.- Solid understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure software delivery, vulnerability management, and security automation.- Proven experience with hybrid infrastructure environments based on VMware ESXi/vSphere and Microsoft Azure.- Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code, like Terraform and Ansible.- Experience with containerized application platforms and OpenShift environments.- Familiarity building or operating internal developer platforms, self-service solutions, or shared engineering platforms.- Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools.- Experience leveraging AI tools in daily engineering workflows to improve productivity, automation, and knowledge sharing.- Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced environments.- Strong communication and collaboration skills across international teams and IT disciplines, including infrastructure, networking, security, and cloud.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.

Vertrauen im digitalen Zeitalter!Bei G+D schaffen wir Vertrauen durch integrierte Sicherheitstechnologien in drei Geschäftsbereichen: Digital Security, Financial Platforms und Currency Technology. Für unsere Kunden sind wir seit 170 Jahren ein verlässlicher Partner. Mit unserem Angebot sind wir bestens aufgestellt, um Sie auf Ihrem Weg in die Zukunft zu begleiten. Entdecken Sie unsere innovativen Lösungen für SecurityTech!About the Role:As a Strategic 3rd pParty Portfolio Manager, you will play a key role in shaping the future of the cash cycle and printworks ecosystem. You will define long-term strategic capabilities, identify emerging technology trends, develop strategic partnerships, and drive portfolio evolution across software, automation, manufacturing, logistics, and digital services.This role combines elements of strategy, business development, portfolio management, and M&A. You will work across organizational boundaries to ensure that G+D develops the right competencies, partnerships, technologies, and business models required to remain a market leader in a rapidly evolving industry.You create clarity on where the market is heading, what capabilities G+D needs to develop, and which partnerships, acquisitions, and investments are required to achieve its long-term strategic ambitions. You shape the future ecosystem of Cash Centers and Printworks, enabling the transition from hardware-centric solutions toward integrated software, service, and platform-based business models while ensuring sustainable growth and long-term competitive advantage.Your Responsibilities:- Define the long-term target architecture and strategic roadmap for future solution projects (Cash Centers, Printworks, and digital currency management solutions) in close collaboration with the Technology and Project Execution department, Strategic Procurement, Strategy, Solution Sales, and colleagues in the strategic portfolio management department CB/PW- Closely analyze today's process and technology landscape in customers' factories, identify unmet customer needs, and derive future requirements for CTCS' solutions portfolio- Analyze supplier markets (G+D group internally as well as externally), existing and upcoming technology trends, and industry developments to identify future upselling opportunities and capability requirements for CTCS' turnkey solutions portfolio- Develop 3rd party portfolio strategies that align customer needs, technological innovation, and business objectives- Create a strategic supplier framework that streamlines the supplier selection process for solution projects taking strategic risks, dependencies, and governance models associated with key partnerships into account- Drive make-buy-partner decisions to determine which capabilities should be developed internally, acquired, or sourced through strategic partners and play a leading role in the establishment of strategic supplier agreements- Develop business cases, financial models, strategic scenarios, and investment recommendations for senior managementYour Profile:- Master's degree in business administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field- Proven experience in Strategy, Portfolio Management, Partner management, Corporate Development, Consulting, or Technology Management- Strong understanding of industrial software, automation, digital transformation, and technology-driven business models- Experience in building strategic partnerships and managing complex stakeholder ecosystems- Strong financial and analytical skills, including business case development, investment evaluation, and strategic planning- Demonstrated ability to influence and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority- Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for creating new business opportunities and driving organizational change- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English, additional languages are a plus

As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. This role combines strong business acumen with expertise in financial controlling, project analysis, and business partnering, leveraging modern ERP systems and advanced analytics tools.The position supports the Exentec Sales organization through high-quality financial reporting and strategic analysis, translating data into actionable insights. In close collaboration with Exentec Sales teams and Global Business Lines management, the position ensures transparency, drives performance, and enables informed decision-making.Working closely with senior management and cross-functional business leaders across multiple geographies, the role plays a key part in enhancing profitability, strengthening financial governance, and fostering a data-driven culture.Explore your tasks and responsibilities- Prepare monthly management reporting (financial statements, pipeline reports, KPI dashboards) using standard tools (Tagetik, SAP, Salesforce) and BI solutions (Power BI, Excel)- Support data extraction, validation, and quality assurance using automated solutions to enhance transparency and data reliability- Contribute to financial controlling across projects and business lines, analyzing performance, cost structures, and variances- Support planning and forecasting cycles, including budgets and strategic business plans, by collecting data, preparing templates, and validating inputs- Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate submission of planning assumptions- Drive operational excellence by improving controlling processes, reducing manual effort, and enhancing data flows- Support automation initiatives and the implementation of new tools- Deliver ad-hoc analyses and reporting for senior management and Global SalesShow your expertiseBachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field- 3+ years of professional experience in controlling, preferably in international industrial companies- Strong MS Office skills, including Power BI and Copilot- Experience with common reporting tools (e.g., Tagetik, Lucanet, Hyperion or similar)- Knowledge of SAP FI/CO is a strong plus- Business fluent English (C-level proficiency)- Open mindset towards BI tools and AI-driven analyticsWhat we offer you- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in GermanyContactYou want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.Job Responsibilities1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries7. Sales Incentive Compensation- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and ITQualifications & Experience- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plusHomeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung
